text:
invoice-bot: New invoice from Tempest Labs: INV-2026-0912 for $7,450. PDF: https://invoices.redwood/INV-2026-0912. Vendor references PO-8891. Auto-extracted GL 4201. Please advise.

lina_fin: PDF shows two line items: ENG consulting $4,950 (PO-8891) and ML training $2,500 (no PO).

raj: Procurement, did we issue a split PO for this order?

amy_ops: No split PO. Vendor only sent PO-8891 on their side. They say they canreissue but need PO number from us.

kevin_s: If AP pays now without fix, the ML $2.5k will be miscoded. Two paths: ask vendor to reissue (audit clean) or post with manual split and approval override (faster).

lina_fin: Due in 7 days. Ill request reissue; if no vendor reply in 24h we do manual split and attach approval notes. @sara who is ML approver?

sara: dr_mitra is approver but OOO Wed-Thu. Can we get delegated approval?

raj: James, can you approve ML line temporarily? Procurement will need to sign off on manual coding.

james_eng: I can sign off for ML if Procurement okays manual split and we attach vendor confirmation and audit note: "Manual split due to vendor invoice constraints; PO pending."

procurement-bot: Heads up: Creating a manual split means the second AP line won't auto-match to PO in Coupa and needs an override. Please attach vendor email confirming allowance.

lina_fin: Email sent to Tempest: "Please reissue INV-2026-0912 with PO-8891 (ENG) and PO-8892 (ML Research $2,500). If you cannot reissue, confirm in writing that Redwood can split and code manually." Included CSR# 48211.

invoice-bot: Vendor replied: "We cannot create PO-8892 on our side; we need you to issue PO-8892 and send it to us to reissue invoice."

raj: Procurement, please create PO-8892 for $2,500 and mark as ML Research. Vendor is waiting.

procurement-bot: PO creation request PR-562 logged. Target to create PO-8892 after approvals (~6 hours ETA). Will update when live.

lina_fin: Okay holding off manual split until PO-8892 exists. If not created by EOD we will do manual split, attach James' approval and vendor email to AP ticket AP-3247.

james_eng: :thumbsup:

amy_ops: Thanks team, keep AP informed so due date isn't missed.
